source.title: Obstacles Avoidance Assistance for Visually Impaired
source.license: CC BY 4.0 (displayed on the official Mendeley v1 page)
source.upstream_provenance: The page says selected images came from public Roboflow datasets and were manually annotated; it does not enumerate upstream dataset IDs or their individual licenses.

source_archive_audit.extraction: performed after source size and SHA-256 verification

source_content.source_image_metadata_scan: sips reported no nontechnical metadata properties for all 1,250 images

prepared_artifact.format: CV_data common object detection; normalized YOLO bbox + JSONL

visual_review.finding: Reviewed examples show walkways, poles, fences, curb/raised-surface conditions, and damaged pavement consistent with the intended broad obstacle classes.
visual_review.limits: Sample-only review. A fence or pole is not necessarily an obstruction; source labels do not encode usable width, route availability, accessibility, or an individual's needs. No full-image human review for faces or vehicle identifiers was performed.

student_use: Prototype a map that marks possible footpath obstacle objects for a person to inspect and annotate. Do not use the model alone for mobility, navigation, safety, or accessibility decisions. Validate local use with local images and affected pedestrians.
attribution: Yi Xian Wang (2025), Obstacles Avoidance Assistance for Visually Impaired, Mendeley Data v1, CC BY 4.0; reorganized without changing image pixels or normalized boxes.
